items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: I know I met his brother in, in, in, I met, ... I don't think of his first name, his last name is Ned, see, because I met his brother

ctx.x: See, then we had, we had Wild Ned, he had another style. He had, he had a high pitch style way up there.
That's the far tape out of Ned.
